projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for Go
description: For Go, Device Detection runs on-premise, and IP Intelligence on-premise or in the cloud. Device Detection is a User-Agent and Client Hints parser that finds the device, browser, operating system, and crawlers, an alternative to UAParser.js, DeviceAtlas, and WURFL. IP Intelligence gives IP geolocation to an approximate city level location, an alternative to MaxMind and IPinfo. Human Confidence and Identifiers, such as the 51Did, come through the 51Degrees cloud service.
